def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people = image_patch.find("person")
    crossings = image_patch.find("zebra crossing")
    
    if not people or not crossings:
        return image_patch
    
    crossing_centers = [(x + width / 2, y + height / 2) for x, y, width, height in crossings]
    people_sorted_by_crossing_distance = sorted(people, key=lambda p: min(distance((p.left + p.width / 2, p.lower + p.height / 2), crossing_center) for crossing_center in crossing_centers))
    
    walking_people = [p for p in people_sorted_by_crossing_distance if p.simple_query("Is the person walking?").lower() == "yes"]
    
    return walking_people
